detail.tolerance: 10 s actual glides at 90%,100%,110% trim speed; positive descent, no arbitrary L/D band; energy residual <1 J + 0.5% losses; independently reconstructed acceleration within .02 m/s².

diagnostics.reference_equations: Independent mass points, centroid, inertia, local sections and coupled E-L solve; no candidate counters/helpers used as expectations.
